audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer calls his E "CH-3X grenade" / "CH-3X Lightning Grenade" in four places while the full layer calls it CH-2 Grenade.
audit.why: Riot's name is CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade. CH-3X Lightning Grenade is a retired name, so the page shipped two different names for the same ability. The mechanic around it is right and stays: the grenade's centre stun lands through Counter Strike, because E dodges attacks (his autos and the turret beam attacks) and the grenade is an ability.
audit.corrected: CH-3X replaced with CH-2 in whys[2], spikes[0].text, spikes[1].text, mid and wants.foe[0]; the stun-through-dodge interaction left as written.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as a flat Jax spike and the 2+ item row gave the stage to Heimerdinger; no cooldowns anywhere.
audit.why: The grenade is 11s flat at every rank — that is the timer the whole lane runs on and it never gets shorter. Micro-Rockets are 11s at rank 1 and UPGRADE!!! is 100s at rank 1. Level 6 is genuinely a coinflip (your resists versus a widened grenade), and two items is firmly yours: he has no dash to escape Leap Strike.
audit.corrected: 11s grenade, 11s rockets and 100s UPGRADE!!! written into the cooldown block and stage whys; level 6 and 2+ items rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Heimerdinger Level 1, Level 6 and the 2+ item row, and called Levels 4-5 Skill — the exact opposite of the page's own whys on four of five rows. diff also read EVEN next to a red tone and 8.5/10.
audit.why: whys[0] calls level 1 "a coinflip", whys[3] calls 4-5 "his strongest window", whys[4] calls 6 "a coinflip", whys[5] says first item "tips to you" and whys[6] says two items is "firmly yours". The packet chart is Skill/Heim/Heim/Heim/Skill/Jax/Jax and agrees with the prose on every row.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 4-5, 6, first item and 2+ items flipped in both layers as one atomic group with ratings moved, and diff set to HARD to match the tone, difficulty and final-rating line.

edits.before: Auto-trade only with E held in your pocket. Identify how Heimerdinger contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: One turret and no grenade yet — a clean leash-leap can win first contact, but his beams and a rocket still chip you.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around CH-2 Grenade's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: His strongest window: two turrets plus a banked grenade (11s) centre-stun any leap, and Counter Strike cannot dodge that stun.

edits.before: Grandmaster’s Might stats win every extended duel from here on. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Heimerdinger's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Your R's burst Armor and MR finally let you survive a trade, but UPGRADE!!! (100s) widens his next grenade, so 6 stays a coinflip.

edits.before: Trinity Force is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on CH-2 Grenade's cooldown.
edits.after: Trinity Force lands: your Empowered landing hit and on-hit ramp out-DPS the whole nest in one all-in.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Heimerdinger carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: you tank the full nest and delete a yordle with no dash to escape. He still zones objectives, so take the side lane.

edits.before: - Heimerdinger CH-2 Grenade: matchup-defining — His self-peel stun. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Heimerdinger CH-2 Grenade: matchup-defining — 11s at every rank, and the centre stun lands through your dodge. Sidestep it. - Micro-Rockets: 11s at rank 1. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: Track Heimerdinger's CH-2 Grenade (Stun): His self-peel stun. Dodge it. When it is down — Q-E-W him.
edits.after: Track CH-2 Grenade (11s): the centre stun goes straight through your dodge. Once spent — Q-E-W him.

edits.before: At level 3 his turret nest plus a banked CH-3X grenade zone your Leap Strike, and the stun lands through Counter Strike since E only dodges basic attacks, not the grenade.
edits.after: At level 3 his turret nest plus a banked CH-2 grenade zone your Leap Strike, and the stun lands through Counter Strike since E only dodges basic attacks, not the grenade.

edits.before: His strongest window: two H-28G turrets up plus a banked CH-3X grenade mean a Q-leap into the nest gets center-stunned and beam-volleyed while you're locked. Counter Strike dodges the turret beams and his autos, but it does NOT dodge the grenade stun, so you get held and melted anyway.
edits.after: His strongest window: two H-28G turrets up plus a banked CH-2 grenade (11s) mean a Q-leap into the nest gets centre-stunned and beam-volleyed while you're locked. Counter Strike dodges the turret beams and his autos, but never the grenade stun, so you get held and melted anyway.

edits.before: Grandmaster at Arms hands you the burst Armor/MR steroid to survive a trade, but UPGRADE!!! also empowers his next CH-3X into a bigger grenade with a wider stun footprint that's harder to sidestep, so don't flip the all-in into a fresh upgraded grenade.
edits.after: Grandmaster at Arms hands you the burst Armor/MR steroid to survive a trade, but UPGRADE!!! (100s at rank 1) empowers his next CH-2 grenade into a bigger blast with a wider stun footprint, so don't flip the all-in into a fresh upgraded grenade.

edits.before: Land the CH-3X grenade the moment you leap in — the stun isn't dodged by Counter Strike, so it locks you for the full turret beam volley and W Micro-Rocket poke
edits.after: Land the CH-2 grenade the moment you leap in — the stun isn't dodged by Counter Strike, so it locks you for the full turret beam volley and W Micro-Rocket poke

edits.before: "This stretch is his, not yours. With two turrets deployed and a CH-3X Lightning Grenade banked, any Leap Strike into his nest gets center-stunned, and you eat the full beam volley and W rockets while locked — the stun is damage Counter Strike can't prevent. At 6 your Grandmaster at Arms steroid finally gives you the burst Armor/MR to survive a trade, but UPGRADE!!! also empowers his next ability — turn it into a bigger grenade with a wider stun footprint, or the slowing Apex turret if he upgrades Q — so don't coinflip the all-in into a fresh upgraded grenade. Farm what you safely can, sidestep the grenade, and wait for your first item."
edits.after: "This stretch is his, not yours. With two turrets deployed and a CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade banked, any Leap Strike into his nest gets centre-stunned, and you eat the full beam volley and W rockets while locked — the stun is damage Counter Strike can't prevent. At 6 your Grandmaster at Arms steroid finally gives you the burst Armor/MR to survive a trade, but UPGRADE!!! empowers his next ability — a bigger grenade with a wider stun footprint, or the slowing Apex turret if he upgrades Q — so don't coinflip the all-in into a fresh upgraded grenade. Farm what you safely can, sidestep the 11s grenade, and wait for your first item."

notes: Wrong-name error of the calibration type: his E was written as "CH-3X grenade" / "CH-3X Lightning Grenade" (a retired name) in the content layer while the full layer used CH-2 — one ability, two names, on the same page. Corrected to CH-2. The interaction itself was already right and I left it: Counter Strike dodges his autos and the turret beam attacks, never the grenade's centre stun. Chart: four rows contradicted the page's own whys and the packet; flipped as one group, and diff EVEN corrected to HARD to match the red tone, the 8.5/10 difficulty line and the final-rating line.
